reason: The service panel is the only available item, and the lander connections are the relevant filling point.
expectation: The command should initiate the separate propellant transfers or reveal what is needed.

effect: The service-panel command completed both separate transfers and filled the ascent tanks, completing the chapter.
reaction: The keyed connections and separate fuel paths made the otherwise indirect command feel physically grounded.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the ascent tanks was worthwhile because it connected the completed fuel plant to the journey home, with clear safeguards for the separate propellants.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter offered only one available item and one hotspot, so there was little decision-making involved.

surprise.text: I was unsure whether the service panel could initiate the transfers; it completed both directly.

arbitrary.text: Using the station service panel at the lander connections felt somewhat indirect, though the result explained the controller's role.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the return and the discovery unfold, though this chapter alone offered little gameplay challenge.
